title: SB3039 (2026 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2026/bills/SB3039_.HTM; sha256 478085a8c6db001b98ed6bb19b5b9aee328895576bd2fa6428ae742e4aa96296)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed; no votes recorded. Section 2 adds a new section to HRS chapter 134 part I (number blank). First sentence quoted is from subsection (a).

operative_text: SECTION 2 (new): A person with a license issued under section 134-9 shall not carry a firearm on the licensee's person within the State without also carrying an electric gun on the licensee's person. (b) A person's license issued under section 134-9 shall be subject to revocation under section 134-13 if the licensee violates subsection (a).
